hypothesis: Many failed sign-ins across several synthetic accounts from one source, followed by one success, indicate password spraying and are distinguishable from an employee mistyping their own password a few times.

network_paths: adversary -> dmz:443 -> internal idp-01 via reverse proxy

benign_control.description: benign-browser signs in as synthetic-user-01 with two wrong passwords then the correct one.
benign_control.differs_by: number of distinct accounts targeted from one source (1 vs 5)

steps.action: auth-sprayer-lab tries one wrong password per synthetic account through https://web-01.northstar.lab/auth, then the known synthetic password for synthetic-user-05
steps.expected: Keycloak records 4 failures and 1 success from 10.77.60.10
steps.stop_condition: any account outside the synthetic-user list, any lockout of an operator account, or more than 50 attempts

expected_triage.detection: spray rule (>=3 distinct users failing from one source in 10 minutes, then success) fires for the run and not for the control

cleanup: Reset synthetic-user-05 password and revoke its sessions in Keycloak
Clear brute-force lockout counters for synthetic users
Verify benign sign-in for synthetic-user-01 succeeds
